detail.longDescription: Think I’m going to learn more about Kubernetes tonight. And not quite in a fun way: one of my containers, and only one so far, doesn’t seem like it retained its data after I took the rack down for maintenance yesterday. All the systems were cleanly shutdown so the data should be intact, I just need to find it. The new PVs are there, but empty, so I might need to see what PVs they *should* be pointing to. # homelab # kubernetes # learning # troubleshooting # selfhosted
